P(blue ∪ green) = 0.58 + 0.45 − 0.22 = 0.81. Neither = 1 − 0.81 = 0.19.

Neither answer is correct (0.19). A says 0.22, B says 0.78. Which is closer/less wrong? Both are wrong. 

A's 0.22 is the intersection value, a misreading. B's 0.78 is 1 − 0.22, a misapplication as well. Both are equally wrong; B is numerically farther (0.59 off vs 0.03 off). A is numerically closer (0.03 off), though by coincidence. Both lack work. I'd call it a tie.
